title: DSource deliverable-pack ground truth
description: Emitted by the generator alongside out/quantity-takeoff.xlsx. This is the geometric truth the workbook, the plan PNG and the renders are all cross-checked against by gates G3 and G6. Every number here comes from the Rust core, never from the spreadsheet.

sqfPerM2.description: Conversion factor used for Inventory 'Area (sqf)'. NOTE: the qbiq reference uses a rounded 10.76; DSource defaults to the true 10.7639. G3 reads --sqf-factor, not this field, so keep them in sync.

walls.description: Wall type -> run length. Keys must match General!J9:J* Material Name exactly. Checked to within 1 cm.

doors.description: Door type -> count. Keys must match General!T9:T* Type Name exactly. Checked for EXACT equality.

doorCount.description: Sum of doors. Optional; checked when present.

rooms.description: One entry per Inventory body row, same order.

roomId.description: Must appear EXACTLY once in planLabels.

floorMaterial.description: Must match a General!B9:B* Material Name.

ceilingMaterial.description: Must match a General!F9:F* Material Name.

planLabels.description: Every room-ID label the plan renderer actually drew on plan.png. G3 asserts a perfect 1:1 correspondence with the Inventory Room IDs — this is what catches rooms that exist in the takeoff but were never drawn (and vice versa).

renders.description: Consumed by G6 to check each still's floor pixels against that room's Inventory floor material.

file.description: Path relative to the repo, or a bare filename resolved inside --renders.

floorRect.description: Fractional (x0,y0,x1,y1) crop of the frame that is predominantly floor. Default [0.05,0.80,0.95,0.98].

rooms.name: office_m
rooms.furnitureElements: Desk Table W70 X L140: 1, Executive  Chairs W58 X L60: 1
